title: CIA Mud Bank — Account Posture Index
rule: This index compares explicit event-ledger adjustments only. Live Dooley Welfare is added separately in the Mud Bank UI and is too small to materially reorder current event balances.
boundary: This is a source-bounded Potatoverse bookkeeping view, not a factual ranking of morality, guilt, trustworthiness, criminality or human worth.
ordering_note: Rows are sorted by net explicit event adjustment for bank readability. Zero does not mean morally neutral; it usually means no responsible price has been established.
